replicaCount.description: kiwiki supports exactly one replica: sessions, OAuth clients, SSE and chunked uploads are process-local state, and the key-attempt counters in app/rate_limit_store default to process-local memory. A second replica would count failures separately and make rate limiting weaker, not stronger. The template additionally fails without a shared store (env.KIWIKI_RATE_LIMIT_STORE=sqlite) and a ReadWriteMany volume if this ceiling is ever raised.

KIWIKI_RATE_LIMIT_STORE.description: Backing store for the API-key attempt counters; required to be sqlite for more than one replica.

KIWIKI_RATE_LIMIT_STORE_PATH.description: Path of the shared SQLite store; needs a ReadWriteMany volume when running multiple replicas.
